name: Transparent TLS-intercepting decrypt mirror (Phase 2)
summary: Phase 2 of the outbound-visibility program: an opt-in, consented, READ-ONLY TLS-intercepting proxy. A local reversible CA mints per-SNI leaves; pf rdr redirects :443 to a local proxy that terminates the client TLS, re-dials the verified upstream, relays byte-for-byte unmodified, and captures the decrypted plaintext (Redact-masked) into an InterceptedFlow streamed to a unix socket and/or a rotating 0600 log, viewed via `console --intercept`. Arm is always reversibly disarmed (exit/panic/signal/--uninstall). The crypto pump + publish sinks are stdlib and CI-tested over loopback and were swarm-reviewed + remediated across cp-p2a..g; the pf/keychain runtime edges are darwin+root, compile-guarded, and UNVERIFIED pending the maintainer's root smoke test. Redact/block is deferred to Phase 3.
targetWindow: feature branch (design/phase2-tls-interception); tag after the root smoke test passes
updateSource: swarm build of Phase 2 (cp-p2a..cp-p2h), fan-out reviewed

required.title: CA + TLS terminate/re-dial/relay pump + publish sinks
required.summary: internal/intercept: reversible P-256 CA with a bounded, expiry-aware per-SNI leaf cache + 0600 persistence (LoadOrCreate, O_EXCL race-safe); the read-only MITM pump (GetCertificate per SNI, honest handshake classification decrypted/pinned/opaque/error, verified upstream re-dial, idle-timeout relay, bounded capture, DecodeCleartext+Redact before the flow exists); publish sinks (non-blocking socket with reader reaping + drop counter, rotating 0600 JSONL log, bounded/sanitized untrusted-input readers).
evidence: cp-p2a..cp-p2d swarm-reviewed + remediated (conn-leak, socket stall, untrusted-input bounds, body-secret masking)

required.title: intercept daemon + console viewer (consent + reliable teardown)
required.summary: `counterspy intercept [--stream[=sock]] [--log[=path]] [--uninstall] [--yes]` (approved flag surface): consent (y/N, --yes bypasses) -> arm trust+redirect with the signal handler registered FIRST -> Proxy.Serve -> reverse-order teardown on exit/panic/signal, reporting revert failures; --uninstall is non-minting + idempotent self-heal. `console --intercept[=sock]` live-tails masked flows (honest status; per-line clean + width cap).
evidence: cp-p2f/cp-p2g swarm-reviewed + remediated (disarm-before-arm-window, loud+complete teardown, race-safe CA, --uninstall no-mint, untrusted-At render)

deferred.title: Redact / block outbound payloads (Phase 3)
deferred.summary: Phase 2 is decrypt/visibility ONLY. Stripping sensitive data from outbound payloads or blocking transmission is deferred to Phase 3 (Rule 16: read-only first establishes the pump + trust model before mutating live traffic, which is higher-risk).

deferred.title: IPv6 original-destination recovery
deferred.summary: OrigDest is IPv4-only; a v6 flow fails loud rather than mis-reporting. Deferred (Rule 16): the AF_INET6 DIOCNATLOOK path + a v6 rdr rule double the unverified ioctl surface, and v4 covers the smoke test.

blockers.title: Runtime pf/keychain edge unverified pending a root smoke test
blockers.summary: The pf rdr redirect, DIOCNATLOOK orig-dest recovery, and System-keychain trust install/teardown can only run as root against a live pf + keychain, so they are compile-guarded + honestly marked unverified. The end-to-end decrypt path must be exercised by the maintainer (sudo) before v0.7.0 can be cut. Also resolves the documented macOS local-outbound rdr direction/loop questions.
